notes.title: New Updates 1.3
notes.content:
Updates for V 1.3
• We have been getting some great feed back and are adding more to the experience. 
• Lots of new improvements and graphics optimization.
• We've added New Discoverables - With every update we are adding special hidden “Discoverables" in the game that you can unlock using any of the tools. Pay special attention and try for find these hidden features:
- Butterfly Doubler
- Bouncing Paintballs
- Try and make Match 3 and Match 5 Combos on the Block Wall
- Butterfly Blaze
• Updated controller functionality. Now you can play with a single controller!
• Wow check out a whole new sky and time additions. Look up and enjoy.
• Fixed some collision issues with the Paintball Blaster

Keep sending us your thoughts to htcviveport@groovejones.com and we appreciate your input.
